conversion.api: originals (/api/v1/originals/plinko/place-bet and /verify), every round of every capture
conversion.order: captures in the order of convert/inputs.plinko.json (the order they were played); inside a capture, the file order of its bet events. Epochs are renumbered 0..N-1 across the captures in that order; seeds[].captureEpoch is the epoch number inside its own capture file
conversion.seedRecords: one per epoch: clientSeed, hashedServerSeed, nextHashedServerSeed, nonceStart from the rotation reply that opened the epoch (the first epoch of a capture: the rotation that closed that capture's pre-capture pair), serverSeed from the rotation reply that closed it; at = that opening rotation; nonceEnd = the last nonce recorded in the epoch; commitVerified = sha256(serverSeed) === hashedServerSeed and chainLinkOk = nextHashedServerSeed === the hash the closing rotation made active, both recomputed by the converter; capture, captureEpoch, phase, phaseId, seedTag (player = a Phase D player-set seed, audit = the runner's per-epoch seed), plannedBets, stake = the runner's epoch event
conversion.captures: meta.captures[i]: the source file and its sha256, the runner build, the plan summary, the first / last epoch and the bet count it contributes, its window, and its own pre-capture anchor (the pair active before its first round and the rotation that revealed it; commitVerified recomputed). The three captures are three separate runs on the same account: the seed chain is asserted inside each capture, not across them

bets.served: id = betId; gameId = the served round.gameId; numberOfRows / riskLevel = servedParams; dropDetails = outcome.drops; winningSlot = outcome.ones; multiplier = outcome.multiplier; nonce, clientSeed, serverSeedId, hashedServerSeed (= serverSeedHash) as served; betAmount = stake, winningAmount: the served strings, unchanged (a WTF round that pays nothing is served "0"); result = the served wager result
bets.recorded: at, phase, phaseId = the runner's record of the round (the 8 Nov capture has no phase id: all its rounds are Phase A, phaseId A); capture = 1-based index into meta.captures; epoch = renumbered as above

recomputed.localPath: src/rng.ts revealPlinko(revealed seed, clientSeed, nonce, rows).path

conversion.phases: meta.phases[letter]: bets and epochs counted from the capture files, stake = the served stake string of every round of the phase (one value, or the converter stops), amount = Number(stake), ids = bets per plan entry (A: A = the 27 standard settings, A+W = the WTF board), epochSizes = the distinct plannedBets of its epochs
